editorial:
Imagine losing the person you love most and then turning to drugs just to stop the pain. That is where you find Jane. After her boyfriend Dax dies from an overdose, Jane starts using too, but she quickly learns that her new habit comes with a terrifying price. You will see that she is not just fighting addiction, but also ghost addicts who want to pull her into their world. The vibe is dark and gritty, making you feel the stress and fear Jane goes through as she meets Rick, another guy fighting off a very mean ghost named Azami. It is a wild ride that blends drug culture with scary spirits.

You will probably love how the tension builds up, though some of the special effects look a bit dated since it is from 2004. The acting feels real, and the way the ghosts pop up will definitely make you jump. If you like stories where the main character is pushed to the edge, you should check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Jane goes home and finds a body in her bed. She flips the person over and realizes it is a dead version of herself. The twist is that Jane had already died from an overdose, and she has been a ghost the whole time. She was just too far gone to realize it. The movie ends with her finally accepting her death as she joins the other spirits in the afterlife.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological horror with a twist ending.
